properties.statement:
REVISED after the root-cause steps I had skipped were actually run (2026-09-05, same day). The first version of this fact named 'a missing setter' as the cause and claimed an asymmetry between Verification and DesignEpoch. BOTH WERE WRONG IN INSTRUCTIVE WAYS; the record below replaces them.

THE SYMPTOM (unchanged): dev_storyflow 2026-09-05 — add_verification without level/method for a static code inspection produced a Verification reading level: unit, method: test; set_verification_kind takes kind only (VerificationKindReq, service.rs:1524), so 'an inspection at system level is recorded as a unit test forever.' And add_epoch produces an epoch reading `arrived`; the reporter avoided the constructor.

THE DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (step ④, which the first version skipped): three candidates — (a) the reading is READER-supplied per dec:the-safe-reading-lives-in-the-reader-not-the-store and nothing is stored; (b) the constructor writes the defaults; (c) schema validation INJECTS every declared default into the store on write. They predict different EXPORTS, because an export omits unset properties. Measured on a fresh graph with the current debug binary: a Verification created with no level/method EXPORTS level=unit, method=test, kind=verification, status=planned. A DesignEpoch created via add_epoch EXPORTS status=arrived. verify.rs:132 uses set_opt (writes nothing on None), so (b) is refuted. (a) is refuted by the export. (c) STANDS: schema.rs validate_node (called on the create_node path both constructors use) inserts a declared default for every missing property — unconditionally, with a test named for it — and its own doc says 'the schema's default IS the value.'

⭐ SO THE ROOT CAUSE IS THE INJECTOR, NOT THE SETTER. Every property that still declares a schema default is written into the store AS IF THE USER CHOSE IT. This is the exact class BL-198 / chg:the-export-round-trip-injected-defaults identified for Artifact.granularity/volatility — and that fix REMOVED those two defaults from the schema; the injector itself was never changed. So every other declared default is still asserted on write. Verification.method default: test, level default: unit (schema/verify.yaml:22,24) are the reporter's instance. A method of `test` written onto an inspection is a false claim on the record, made by the tool, with no field the user filled.

WHERE THE EPOCH DIFFERS, AND IT IS A JUDGEMENT NOT A MECHANISM: DesignEpoch.status's schema description ARGUES its injected `arrived` is 'a record, not a choice' because add_epoch had only ever created points that already exist. Whether that still holds now that planning is a first-class act (cap:planned-epochs) is a fair question, but it was decided deliberately. Verification.level/method carry no such argument.

WHO READS THEM: nothing. heal.rs:1225 reads COMPONENT.level, not Verification's; no detector reads Verification.method. dec:idea-a-capability-checked-only-at-unit-level already noted the field is 'recorded and never read.' Removing the defaults therefore changes no detector.

THREE FIXES, NOW RANKED BY CAUSE: (1) ROOT — remove the schema defaults from Verification.level and .method so absence means nobody said, the Artifact precedent exactly; (2) the reporter's alternative — make add_verification REFUSE to proceed without method/level rather than default silently; (3) SYMPTOM — let set_verification_kind accept level/method so a false claim can at least be corrected. (3) is worth having regardless; (1) is the fix that stops the class. (1) touches the schema, so it is the owner's call. Whether add_epoch's `arrived` should ALSO stop being injected is a second, separate ruling.

WHAT I GOT WRONG AND HOW: the first probe passed epoch_type: 'increment', which is not in the enum, so add_epoch was REFUSED, the node never existed, and I read the resulting absence as 'epochs are not injected.' The skill's candidate 'the observation itself is wrong' was correct and I had not listed it. The reading came from not checking the add_epoch reply's isError before trusting the get_node. rule:success-is-read-from-the-authoritative-object, again.
properties.value: {"root_cause":"validate_node injects every declared schema default into the store on write; Artifact fix removed defaults, never changed the injector","measured":"export of fresh Verification carries level=unit, method=test, kind, status; epoch carries status=arrived","refuted":["reader-supplied","constructor writes them"],"readers_of_verification_level_method":"none","fixes_ranked":["remove schema defaults on Verification.level/method (root, owner call)","add_verification refuses silent default","setter accepts level/method (symptom)"],"my_error":"illegal epoch_type made add_epoch refuse; read absence as asymmetry"}
